notes.title: Important: Save Your Progress Before Updating
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have accidentally included test save files in the previous build, which might overwrite your existing save data. To avoid any accidental loss of progress, please back up your save files before updating the game.

To further ensure your save data is protected, we recommend changing your Steam settings to update the game manually. Here’s how you can do it:

[h3]How to Change Steam Settings for Manual Updates:[/h3]
[b]Open Steam and Go to Your Library:[/b]
[list]
[*] Launch the Steam client on your computer.
[*] Click on the "Library" tab to view your list of games.
[/list]
[b]Locate "Escape from the Cursed Convent Playtest"[/b]
[list]
[*] Find "Escape from the Cursed Convent Playtest" in your list of games.
[*] Right-click on the game title and select "Properties".
[/list]
[b]Adjust Update Settings:[/b]
[list]
[*] In the properties window, go to the "Updates" tab.
[*] Under "Automatic Updates", select "Only update this game when I launch it" from the dropdown menu.
[/list]
[b]Backup Your Save Files:[/b]
[list]
[*] Navigate to your save files directory, typically found at:
[*] C:\Users\YourUsername\Documents\Escape from the Cursed Convent\Saves
Copy and paste your save files to a safe location on your computer.
[/list]

After making these changes, you can manually update the game at a convenient time, ensuring your save data is safely backed up.

We have removed the test save files in the latest build to prevent this issue from recurring. Thank you for your understanding and support.

Best regards,
Ais Kacang Studio
